title: Vegan Pizza Showdown: LA Pizza 108 Tasting and Studio-Crafted Vegan Pizza

locations.name: Los Angeles, CA (Pizza 108 visit)

summary: In this Goodful feature, Merl and Tucker chase vegan pizza credibility across two formats: a trip to Pizza 108 in Los Angeles to sample a top vegan pie, followed by a studio baking session where they build a fully vegan pizza from scratch. The studio portion features a cashew-based vegan mozzarella, a gluten-based vegan pepperoni split into a log and steamed, and a tofu-mushroom sausage, all shaped, topped, and baked on a Neapolitan-style dough. They compare the LA visit with Prime Pizza and their studio creation, then rate each pie. Along the way, they discuss technique (dough characteristics, melt/stretch of vegan cheese, and texture of vegan meats) and ethics (veganism and environmental considerations) as part of the tasting commentary.

Vegan pepperoni technique: vital wheat gluten base, fennel, smoked paprika, red pepper flakes; steaming
Vegan sausage technique: tofu base with mushroom, cornstarch, and flour; crumbling and forming
Dough shaping: hand-stretch and round pizza form
Cheese melt and stretch considerations in vegan cheese
Saucing and topping integration with vegan meats
Flavor and texture evaluation during tasting
Environmental/ethical discussion tied to vegan choices

Viewer engagement and call for suggestions
